items:
Welcome to Calico Scallop, a vibrant and stylish home just steps from Crystal Beach Park. This chic haven combines modern design with endless amenities, offering a perfect group getaway for those looking to make the most of their Destin vacation.

Step into a world of beautifully designed interiors, where vibrant pops of color meet modern, chic decor. The living room features cozy seating, a smart TV, and bookshelves filled with thoughtful accents and games. Whip up your favorite dishes in the fully equipped kitchen, complete with stunning cabinetry and stainless-steel appliances, and enjoy meals in the sunlit dining area.

Inside, you’ll find not one but two fun game areas. The upstairs lounge is equipped with a foosball table, shuffleboard, and plush seating to gather for friendly competition. Head to the game garage for even more fun, featuring a turf putting green, ping pong table, arcade games, and cornhole.

The home offers five bedrooms, four in the main house and one in the charming carriage house. One bedroom has 2 sets of twin bunks, and one bedroom has a king with a twin daybed and pullout trundle, while all other beds in the home are king. With five full bathrooms, everyone will enjoy convenience and privacy.

Step outside to soak up the Florida sunshine, where a private pool awaits for refreshing swims and poolside relaxation. Lounge on the comfortable deck chairs under the swaying palm trees or slip into the hot tub to unwind after a day of beach adventures. When golden hour hits, fire up the grill for an evening BBQ.

Located just steps from Crystal Beach Park, Calico Scallop offers unbeatable proximity to the emerald waters of the Gulf Coast. Spend your days lounging on the sugar-white sands or exploring nearby shops and restaurants. Afterward, retreat to the home’s private balconies to enjoy a quiet moment and take in the coastal breeze.

With its playful game areas, luxurious outdoor amenities, and thoughtfully designed interiors, Calico Scallop is more than just a vacation rental—it’s your home away from home. Whether you're here for family fun, a friends' getaway, or a special celebration, this Destin gem promises an unforgettable stay.

Book your stay at Calico Scallop today and discover the ultimate beachside escape!

Located in Northwest Florida, Destin is dubbed the “world's luckiest fishing village.” This Emerald Coast city is known for its sparkling white beaches, numerous golf courses, and world-famous fishing. Nearby zipline courses, dolphin cruises, and amusement parks make it a perfect destination for families. Adults and large groups also come here for beach parties during the day and live music at night.

Local Attractions: Destin Commons, Silversands Outlets, Crab Island, Dolphin Tours, Charter Offshore Fishing, Big Kahuna’s Water and Adventure Park, Crackings, Louisiana Lagniappe, Jackacuda’s Seafood + Sushi

Home Truths:
- This home allows pets for a fee. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval, there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- Pool heat is a paid feature and must be requested 24-48 hours before the day of check-in.
- Pool heat will not be available for the summer months (April 1 - October 31).

Parking Details:
- Parking for vehicles is limited to the driveway boundary only. No vehicles shall be parked on any streets, sidewalks, lawns, or vacant lots. Violations of the parking policy will result in towing at the owner's expense, without notice. This policy is strictly enforced to ensure that emergency vehicles have clear access through the streets at all times.

---

The room configuration is as follows:
Primary Bedroom / King bed
Bedroom 2 / King bed
Bedroom 3 / King bed
Bedroom 4 / 2 Twin beds
Bedroom 5 (Carriage House) / King bed, Twin bed with a trundle

​​​​​​​---

This is a smoke-free property. Violation of the no-smoking policy will result in forfeiture of the security deposit, a $300 smoking fee, and liability for any fire or property damage costs.

As part of our commitment to being good neighbors, occupancy limits and quiet hours (9pm-8am) are strictly enforced. No speakers or sound systems will be provided for use in our properties. Violation of any noise ordinances will be subject to fines that can reach up to $10,000 per violation.

Events or parties are not allowed without prior written approval and an additional fee. Any unauthorized parties or events will be shut down and a fine will be assessed. Please inquire for more information about our event policies and fees.

There is nothing more important to us at AvantStay than the health, safety, and experience of our guests & staff. We've enhanced our cleaning and sanitation protocols and are taking extra care to disinfect all surfaces between reservations with hospital-grade disinfecting solutions.

As a reminder, we do work with 3rd party vendors to maintain the property, and although we adhere to the strictest CDC guidelines and advise all contractors to wear PPE equipment, we can not always enforce. We strongly advise guests to please deny access if any vendors fail to meet and adhere to these standards.

IDs will be requested for verification after booking. All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit.

We report and prosecute all Credit Card Fraud.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
